issues.title: Scroll-to-bottom button overlaps message text
issues.description: The MessageScrollerButton floating action is positioned directly over the text content of the latest message, obstructing readability.
issues.evidence: The circular down-arrow button is rendered on top of the text in the 09:49 message, obscuring part of the word 'approves' so it reads 'Once billing [arrow] oves'.
issues.suggestion: Position the MessageScrollerButton in a dedicated anchored overlay position (e.g., bottom-right with adequate margin) and ensure it does not obstruct reading flow.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: the button was absolutely centered over the reading flow (bottom-4 left-1/2). Fixed by anchoring it bottom-end inside a 48px footer lane the scroller now reserves under the viewport whenever the transcript can scroll, so it can never cover message text.

issues.title: Scroll button overlaps message content
issues.description: The scroll-to-bottom floating button overlays the text within the lowest message bubble.
issues.evidence: The down-arrow circle directly collides with the message text at the bottom center of the message viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom inset to the scroller viewport so floating controls do not obscure message content.
issues.triageNote: Real defect, corroborated independently by pair-009; browser measurement confirmed the lowest right-aligned customer bubble overlapped the corner-anchored button 32x32px. Fixed with the same reserved footer lane (pb-12 when scrollable) under the viewport.

issues.title: Message bubble clipped at top viewport boundary
issues.description: The topmost message bubble is abruptly cut in half at the upper boundary of the message scroller viewport.
issues.evidence: A partially clipped container edge and truncated text fragment are visible directly beneath the header divider at the top edge of the message area.
issues.suggestion: Add top padding or a subtle scroll fade mask to the MessageScrollerViewport to avoid harsh text clipping at the scroll container edge.
issues.triageNote: Real (by design the last-anchor position leaves a 64px peek of the previous turn clipped at the top edge); fixed with state-gated 24px from-background gradient fades on the container that dissolve content crossing either viewport edge.
